woods.name: Trouble in the Woods
woods.description: Defeat 5 mossling slimes along the east road or in Briar Meadow. Return to Rowan.

herbs.name: A little green medicine
herbs.description: Gather 3 silverleaf herbs in the wilderness. Bring news to Rowan.

keeper.name: A friendly face
keeper.description: Meet Elowen beside the village wishing stone. Return to Rowan.

crypt.name: Beneath the old roots
crypt.description: Find a stairway into the Forgotten Crypt. Return to Rowan.
